entries.title: Nahum 2:1
segments: ¶He that dasheth in pieces is come up against thy face: keep the fortress, watch the way, make [thy] loins strong, fortify [thy] power mightily.

entries.title: Nahum 2:2
segments: For Jehovah hath brought again the glory of Jacob, as the glory of Israel; for the wasters have wasted them, and marred their vine-branches.

entries.title: Nahum 2:3
segments: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots [glitter] with the sheen of steel, in the day of his preparation, and the spears are brandished.

entries.title: Nahum 2:4
segments: The chariots rush madly in the streets, they justle one against another in the broad ways: the appearance of them is like torches, they run like lightnings.

entries.title: Nahum 2:5
segments: He bethinketh him of his nobles: they stumble in their march; they make haste to the wall thereof, and the shelter is prepared.

entries.title: Nahum 2:6
segments: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace melteth away.

entries.title: Nahum 2:7
segments: And it is decreed: she shall be uncovered, she shall be led away, and her maids shall moan as with the voice of doves, drumming upon their breasts.

entries.title: Nahum 2:8
segments: Nineveh hath been like a pool of water, since the day she existed, yet they flee away. ...Stand! Stand! But none looketh back.

entries.title: Nahum 2:9
segments: Plunder the silver, plunder the gold; for there is no end of the splendid store of all precious vessels.

entries.title: Nahum 2:10
segments: She is empty, and void, and waste; and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and writhing pain is in all loins, and all their faces grow pale.

entries.title: Nahum 2:11
segments: ¶Where is [now] the den of the lions, and the feeding-place of the young lions, where the lion, the lioness, [and] the lion's whelp walked, and none made them afraid?

entries.title: Nahum 2:12
segments: The lion tore in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

entries.title: Nahum 2:13
segments: Behold, I am against thee, saith Jehovah of hosts: and I will burn her chariots into smoke; and the sword shall devour thy young lions, and I will cut off thy prey from the earth; and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
